# Our approach

## Welcome to PPADEM

Political Parties and Democracy in Africa (PPADEM) is a collaborative multi-year
research project on the role of political parties in shaping democracy across Africa.

- 80 political parties
- 25 countries
- 6 active workstreams

## Two columns

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column}
**Research**

Comparative analysis of party systems, party finance and electoral law.
:::

::: {.column}
**Engagement**

Working with parties, parliaments and civil society.
:::

::::
